about.title: About Conecta Doe
about.purposeText: Conecta Doe is a social-impact platform concept connecting equipment donors with people who need assistive technology.
about.missionText: Connect people through the donation and reuse of assistive technology, supporting independence, inclusion and quality of life.
about.visionText: Become a leading platform connecting assistive technology donors and recipients.
about.valuesText: Solidarity • Inclusion • Empathy • Transparency • Accessibility • Sustainability
about.notice: Demo project: no real donations, institutional results or partnerships.

registration.chooseTitle: How would you like to take part?
registration.chooseDescription: Fill out a demo registration to preview your profile or request. No information will be saved.
registration.volunteerDescription: Want to contribute your time? Share which activities you can help with, without providing personal contact details.
registration.patientDescription: For patients and anyone who needs day-to-day assistance. Describe only the support you need, without diagnoses or health information.
registration.safetyNotice: This is a prototype only. Use a nickname and general information. Do not enter an ID number, phone number, home address, diagnosis, medical history or other sensitive details.
registration.namePlaceholder: How would you like to appear?
registration.offerPlaceholder: E.g., I can teach people how to use apps and online services.
registration.needPlaceholder: E.g., I would like guidance on using public-service apps.
registration.offerHint: Describe the support you can offer (at least 20 characters).
registration.needHint: Describe only the support you need (at least 20 characters). Do not include medical information.
registration.acknowledgement: I understand this registration is a demo and nothing will be sent or saved.
registration.errorDescription: Complete the required information before continuing.
registration.errorName: Enter at least 2 characters for your name or nickname.
registration.errorSummary: Describe the support in at least 20 characters.
registration.errorAgree: Confirm that you understand this is a demo registration.
registration.successDescription: This is a preview of the profile you filled out. It exists only on this screen and has not been published to anyone else.
registration.notSaved: No real registration was created: your details were not sent or stored.
